title: Iteratively refined lower-precision multilevel smoother application
evidence: Large connected tower/dense cases spend109/32ms full steps mostly in multilevel iteration. Small-component N13 already qualifies guarded mixed arithmetic; large-component triangular applications still use FP64. Lower-precision preconditioning with authoritative residual checks is supported as a general approach in NVIDIA research, not as a guarantee for this CG recurrence.
proposed_mechanism: Apply the existing6x6 factors in FP32 only in the V-cycle, refine within the call using at most two FP64 residual corrections to a1e-14 local backward-error gate, and use original FP64 application for conversion-range or residual failures. Keep original FP64 factors/operators/residuals and all application gates. No new allocations/launches, no across-tick convergence or changed caps.
affected_scenarios: all cities as unchanged small-component and setup controls
estimated_application_ms_saved: Low-confidence0 to40ms tower,0 to10ms dense; verification/extra registers can erase savings. No expected small-component city gain.
confidence: Medium physical-quality protection from unchanged outer gates plus local backward checks; low performance confidence until resources/timing measured.
experiment_cost: Two private headers; existing independent hierarchy/cycle/current-load and memory oracles; four targeted20/20/20 cases and light before any full-suite acceptance.
supporting_measurements: Cheaper time to the original convergence/physical quality without excessive new iterations, spills or city regressions.
refuting_measurements: Changed material verdict or force/motion gate failure, fallback/check cost or occupancy loss removes application gain.

research.relevance: Primary-source general method: lower-precision solves accelerate a system while residuals and convergence remain authoritative. Its hardware, algorithms and reported speedups are not predictions here.

scope: Independent compatible baseline. No N21 reciprocal cache or other candidate composition. Preserve even the existing2e-12 internal cycle linearity/symmetry oracle. The earlier unbuilt design using a1e-5 local guard is superseded before any GPU experiment; no tolerance is relaxed. No completed-experiment credit until measured.
